# HolyCrab Agent Tools v0.7.1

Adds MiniMax H3 Highspeed (768P) and H3 Lite (480P/768P), both 4–15 integer seconds, to CLI, MCP and creative workflows. The catalog now contains 13 video, 4 image and 1 audio models. Existing v0.7.0 creative workflows and local composition remain available.

Text generation requires a concrete ratio. Highspeed references support adaptive; Lite references require a concrete ratio. First/last-frame requests use adaptive. Prompt limits match the backend (7000 UTF-16 code units). Material validation stays backend-owned; failed estimates never submit a paid task. Existing price rechecks and uncertain-outcome recovery remain in place.

Skill content version is 1.0.1 with CLI 0.7.1 as its minimum runtime. Distribution bundles and both installers are generated from the runtime inventory. Upgrade from 0.7.0 preserves configuration, Skills ownership and workflow records.

Both new models completed one authorized minimum-spec real generation, download and full media decode (18 and 8 credits). A 4-second request returned 3.75 seconds for Highspeed and 4.46 seconds for Lite; exact output duration is not guaranteed. Automated coverage includes all 18 model routes and unchanged v0.7.0 creative workflows. Native Windows/Linux CI and draft installation are required before publication. Existing authorization/upload evidence is reused only for byte-identical components; no new identity verification or personal upload is claimed. Kling is not included.

## Download reliability fixes

Workflow downloads retain the absolute destination approved in the estimate even after changing the working directory or home. Empty successful HTTP responses are rejected before file replacement, preserving existing output and cleaning temporary files. Independent review reproduced both failures; regression tests cover relative/home paths and empty fixed-length, chunked and lengthless responses.
